reason: Cutting the marked drum wall seems like a direct way to make the viewing openings.
expectation: I expect the scissors to cut openings or prepare the strip for forming the drum, though the exact cuts are unclear.

alternatives.reason: The spindle and base should help the drum turn, but I want to prepare its wall first.

effect: The cuts made viewing slits, so the wall is ready to be joined.
reaction: The slits make the picture-show mechanism a little more intriguing.
reason: Seam tape should join the prepared wall into a drum.
expectation: I expect the slit wall to form a closed cylinder.

alternatives.reason: The turning platform is also needed, but I want to finish forming the wall first.

effect: The wall is now a cylinder, ready for a floor.
reason: Adding the floor should complete the drum itself.
expectation: I expect a slotted drum with a round floor, ready to mount on the turning platform.

alternatives.reason: The turning platform is also needed, but I prefer to finish the drum first.

effect: The drum now has a floor; the turning support remains to be assembled.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it should provide the drum’s turning support.
expectation: I expect a stable base with a spindle and platform for the drum.

effect: The turning support is ready to receive the drum.
reaction: The turntable came together as expected.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should mount the drum for turning.
expectation: I expect a slotted drum that can turn on the base.

effect: The drum is mounted and turns smoothly, completing the goal; the passing slits are ready for a picture show, though the drum is still empty.
reaction: Seeing the twelve windows pass was satisfying, but I was curious to see pictures in motion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting and turning the drum was the most worthwhile moment: the separate parts finally became a working mechanism.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the floor was straightforward but less interesting on its own; it had no explanation beyond the resulting part.

surprise.text: The finished drum had twelve narrow windows passing the eye in sequence; I had not known their number.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary. The parts had clear construction purposes, although the menu supplied compatible pairs.

continue.text: I would continue to see how pictures become an animation through the slits; this chapter built an intriguing mechanism but stopped before showing that effect.
